title: Leap Year
story: The village calendar needs to know whether a year has 366 days.
goal: Read a year. Print leap if it is divisible by 4, except century years, unless divisible by 400. Otherwise print not leap.
starter:
year = int(input())
# 1900 is not a leap year, 2000 is, 2024 is
hints: Write the rule in three parts: divisible by 4, not by 100, or by 400.
Combine them: divisible by 4 and (not by 100 or by 400).

year = int(input())
leap = year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)
print("leap" if leap else "not leap")
socratic: Is 1900 divisible by 4? Should it be a leap year?
Which year is the exception to the exception?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Leap Year”?
solution:
year = int(input())
leap = year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)
print("leap" if leap else "not leap")
